team.name: echo-intel-demo
team.description: 回声智能最小可运行 Demo：严格对齐 V2.0 客户服务 Team 与平台运营 Team，验证售前到交付闭环覆盖；含多轮澄清 Human-in-the-Loop 协议（场景 1 模糊需求必须问用户，不猜测）。

creation_policy.rule: Create the next business Worker only after the previous Worker is created and verified healthy. During Team creation, manager must create customer-journey-leader as a dedicated TeamLeader Worker (role = Customer Journey Leader).

team_leader.name: customer-journey-leader
team_leader.creation: created by manager during Team creation
team_leader.rule: Must be created as a new independent Worker and designated as TeamLeader. Do not designate any business Worker as leader.

task_submission_policy.mention: （无需 @，将需求整体发给 Manager 房间即可）
task_submission_policy.rule: AgentTeams 的 Worker/Leader 为被动调度：用户必须在 Manager 房间发送需求，由 Manager 调度 customer-journey-leader，Leader 再调度各业务 Worker。不要在 Team 房间直接 @leader（不会触发响应）。逐条发送，等报告输出后再发下一条。详见 at/send_to_manager.md。
task_submission_policy.note: 本字段为回填修正（2026-08-16 @hotcoffeeshake）：原「Team 房间 @leader」描述与运行行为不一致，真实机制以 at/send_to_manager.md 为准。

workflow.task: clarify requirement into profile; key-field missing -> status=CLARIFYING + questions (max 2 per round)

CLARIFICATION GATE: if status=CLARIFYING or confidence<0.7 -> pause pipeline (no offer_generation), journey=WAITING_CUSTOMER, send CLARIFYING_REPORT to Manager room; on user reply merge answer and re-dispatch requirement_diagnosis with full clarification history (loop until READY or round>max_rounds)
generate offers and verify feasibility (only when status=READY; missing key fields -> BLOCKED)
compose final recommendation report (or handoff package if clarification rounds exhausted)
collect failed/trend events from 客户服务 Team

clarification_policy.gate_rule: customer_journey_leader MUST NOT dispatch offer_generation while requirement_diagnosis status != READY; guessing or default-filling key fields is forbidden
clarification_policy.escalation_chain: requirement-diagnosis -> customer-journey-leader -> Manager room -> user; user reply returns via Manager room with CLARIFYING_REPORT context
clarification_policy.fallback: round > max_rounds with missing key fields -> handoff_needed=true + templated handoff package (collected fields, open questions, rounds log, session summary) and terminate

kpi.name: 待支付订单创建成功率
关键字段猜测次数
kpi.target: =0（模糊需求必须触发 CLARIFYING 问用户）
